english.title: Make statement / provide information that is false or misleading in relation to equine ID
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[made a statement,]_
(B)_[provided information,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY STATEMENT OR INFORMATION..), that was false or misleading

(C)_[when applying for an ID to be issued or varied]_
(D)_[in relation to the entering of information into an ID or the registration of an ID]_
(E)_[to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person acting in relation to the enforcement of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019 or Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2015/262]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 24 and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
make a statement / provided information
that was false or misleading
when applying for an ID document to be issued / varied OR
in relation to entering information into an ID or the registration of an ID OR
to any person acting in relation to the enforcement of Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019 or the Commission Implementing Regulation (EU 2015 / 262)

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
